{"id":10993,"platform":"ios","refero_url":"https://refero.design/flows/10993","name":"Create daily memory with photo","screens_count":9,"description":"Happy path for creating a daily memory/entry and attaching a photo. Entry point: daily timeline view for a specific date with category icons across the top. When there are no saved memories the screen shows an empty state with a prominent + control to add a memory. User taps +, types a text entry, optionally taps the image icon to attach a photo (system photo-permission prompt -> photo grid -> choose image). User finishes by tapping Done which saves the entry and returns to the dated timeline where the new memory is shown as a card (thumbnail + text). The user can tap the attached image to view it fullscreen. Assumptions: user is on a mobile device, not initially granted photo access, and is interacting while viewing a single date/category.","problem":"User task (user perspective): Create and save a daily memory/reflection for a selected date and category, optionally attach a photo from the device, and review the saved memory. The user expects a simple write flow with an easy way to add an image, clear permission handling if photo access is required, and confirmation that the entry was saved and can be viewed. Interface perspective: The UI provides a date/category selector, an empty-state CTA to add a memory, a minimal writing surface with a visible image attachment icon and a Done action. If photo access is needed the app displays the system permission dialog, then a photo picker grid. After selecting an image the picker closes, a thumbnail card appears above the text editor, and tapping Done stores the memory and returns to the date view. Outcome: User-perceived outcome — a new memory card appears on the selected date with text and an attached image; system-level outcome — the entry is persisted (saved) and the app has either requested (or been granted) photo-library access to allow selection.","app":{"id":268,"name":"one year","description":"capture one memory every day","background_url":"https://images.refero.design/backgrounds/app_268/aa7afef3-2fc1-4122-a4df-3ce6f5f76145.jpg","refero_url":"https://refero.design/apps/268","categories":["Health & Wellness"],"icon_url":"https://images.refero.design/favicon/app_268/dcc9e5ac-0c2c-4809-a47e-c09485c88d4c.jpg","background_color":"81a0fe"},"steps":[{"name":"Date timeline / empty state","screen_id":"f44382f1-cccb-428f-8d9f-549a15b04d88","refero_url":"https://refero.design/screens/f44382f1-cccb-428f-8d9f-549a15b04d88","thumbnail_url":"https://images.refero.design/screenshots/268/mobile/77bea6ae-5f53-4a2a-a95c-bc12899d626c_thumb.jpg","goal":"See today's date and whether any memory exists for the selected category","action":"User observes the empty state and taps the central + button (or bottom category selector) to add a memory","system_response":"App opens a new entry editor for the selected date/category (keyboard may appear if the text field is focused)","ux_patterns":["Empty State","Date & Time"],"ui_elements":["Carousel","Floating Button","Switch & Toggle","Icon","Illustration","Tabbar"],"content":{"description":"Overall visual style: Minimal, soft, hand-drawn playful aesthetic with a light neutral background and a saturated purple/indigo accent used for icons, text, and selected states. The design uses hand-drawn / sketchy iconography in a consistent purple stroke. Typography appears to use a monospaced or typewriter-like font (rounded monospace) for labels and small captions, lending a friendly, diary-like feel.

Color palette (recommended matches):
- Background (whole screen): very light gray - Hex #E9EAEA (RGB 233,234,234)
- Primary accent (icon strokes, text): vivid violet-blue - Hex #3B2AFF (RGB 59,42,255)
- Selected fill (medium lavender block behind selected icon): light lavender - Hex #DCCFFF (RGB 220,204,255) or slightly desaturated #E6E4FF
- Selected active fill (deep selected pill / square): deep indigo - Hex #2D05D8 (RGB 45,5,216)
- Secondary stroke (lighter icons / disabled): low-opacity primary: rgba(59,42,255,0.35)
- Shadows: soft gray shadow under floating elements: rgba(25,25,25,0.10) with spread and blur

Typography:
- Main caption / date: Monospaced type (eg. 'Courier Prime' or 'Roboto Mono'), weight Regular, size ~14pt (iOS points) with letter-spacing slightly increased (0.8px). Color primary accent (#3B2AFF).
- Empty state label "no memory": same monospace font, size ~16pt, weight Regular, centered, color primary accent. Lowercase styling used.
- Micro labels inside bottom pill: 12–13pt monospace, primary color or on-lavender depending on selection.

Key UI elements and styles:
- Status bar: iOS status bar at the very top (time left, signal/battery right). Keep native sizing.
- Date label: centered under the status bar, small monospaced text reading e.g. "sunday, 02.15" in primary purple (#3B2AFF). Vertical spacing from top ~18–26pt.
- Horizontal icon carousel (category selector): a single-row horizontally scrollable area centered beneath the date. Icons are hand-drawn line illustrations in purple stroke (~2.5–3px stroke), each spaced evenly. The carousel shows faint partial icons left/right cut off to indicate horizontal scroll.
  - Icon sizes: stroke icons about 28–34px in visual height. Each icon sits inside a transparent circular touch target of ~56px diameter.
  - Selected icon: shown as a rounded square tile (approx 56–64px) with a light lavender background (#DCCFFF / #E6E4FF), a subtle inner rounded border (1px, rgba(59,42,255,0.06)), and an inner glow / drop shadow (blur ~18–24px, rgba(25,25,25,0.08)). Selected icon stroke uses the primary purple (#3B2AFF). The selected tile is slightly elevated (scale ~1.05) compared to unselected icons.
- Main canvas: large empty area occupying the middle of the screen, background remains the light gray. Visual emphasis is on emptiness to show no content.
- Primary call-to-action (center): a circular hand-drawn plus inside a hand-drawn circle. This tappable control is rendered in the primary purple stroke (#3B2AFF) with a light irregular circular stroke around it giving a doodle effect. Size: symbol ~36–44px, outer doodle circle approx 84–96px diameter; touch target recommended 88–96px. It appears visually centered horizontally and positioned vertically slightly above the lower third (about 45–55% of screen height).
- Empty state label: the phrase "no memory" sits directly under the plus icon, centered, using the same monospaced type, primary purple. Spacing between icon and text ~14–18px.
- Bottom control (persistent): a rounded rectangular pill centered close to the bottom safe area (floating card). This pill has a light lavender fill (#E6E4FF), inner rounded border (1px, rgba(59,42,255,0.08)), strong drop shadow (blur 36px, rgba(25,25,25,0.12)), and contains a small inline row of 3–4 hand-drawn icons. One of these is highlighted as an active tab with a darker, saturated solid rounded square fill (deep indigo #2D05D8) and the flower icon inverted (white stroke). Pill size approx width 240–280px, height 64–78px; inside padding 12–16px. Corner radius ~14–18px.

States & micro-interactions:
- Icon selection: tapping a top icon animates tile scale (0.95 -> 1.05) and tint; selected icon receives the lavender filled rounded square and a slight shadow. Unselected icons fade to ~35% opacity.
- Bottom pill selection: tapping an icon inside the pill switches that quick category — the corresponding item animates to deep indigo filled square and others revert. The pill casts a soft shadow and slightly elevates on press (translateY -6px, ease-out 160ms).
- Add action: tapping the central plus opens a modal or creation flow (not shown) — animate with scale-up and fade-in. The plus has a subtle pulse when idle (very gentle, 1.05 scale cycle over 2400ms) to invite interaction.

Layout spacing & alignment (approx):
- Screen width: full mobile width. Use safe area insets for top/bottom.
- Top cluster: y offset ~44–64pt from top of screen to the center of the carousel row. Date is directly above the icons and horizontally centered.
- Icons: horizontal row centered; left and right padding relative to screen edges ~18–24pt so partial icons are visible as peek indicators.
- Central CTA region: centered horizontally; vertical center of plus sits around 45–55% of the screen height depending on device.
- Bottom pill: bottom of pill sits ~14–20pt above the bottom safe area; horizontally centered.

Accessible considerations:
- All interactive elements have large touch targets (min 44x44pt). Provide sufficient contrast for text when placed on dark fills (invert stroke color to white on deep indigo).
- Provide motion-reduced alternatives for pulsing animations.

Animation details (recommended):
- Selection scale: 120–160ms ease-out scale and shadow increase. Use easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
- Shadow and elevation: soft shadow transition 140ms ease-out.
- Plus modal: use scale 0.9 -> 1.0 with opacity 0 -> 1 over 240ms easing ease-out.

Result: The design communicates an empty memory/moments screen for a particular category (top icons), invites users to add content via a prominent hand-drawn plus, and provides quick category switching with a floating bottom pill. The style is intentionally soft, playful, and diary-like with purple hand-drawn illustrations and subtle depth through shadows.","layout":"Single-column vertical layout with three horizontal groups stacked top -> middle -> bottom.

Top group (1 row):
- Group contains date label centered, and directly beneath it a horizontally scrollable carousel of small handwritten icons. This is a single row that centers horizontally and allows overflow to show partial icons on left/right. Column count: effectively 1 row with multiple item columns equal to number of categories (approx 7 icons visible in screenshot). Group padding left/right ~18–24pt.

Middle group (1 column):
- Large empty canvas occupying most vertical space. Centered column containing the primary floating CTA (plus) and a single text label under it. There are no grid elements — just one central block vertically centered within the available space.

Bottom group (1 row centered):
- Persistent rounded pill (floating card) centered horizontally near the bottom. Inside the pill is an inline row of 3–5 small icons; one is highlighted as the active tile. The pill is effectively a single-row control and acts like a middle-of-screen tabbar. Pill aligns horizontally center and respects bottom safe area.

Columns and groups summary:
- Count of vertical groups: 3 (top carousel group, middle main canvas group, bottom pill group).
- The top carousel is a horizontal list with multiple columns (icons) and paging/scroll behavior. No explicit multi-column grid elsewhere.

Keywords to describe layout: centered, single-column, floating-card, horizontal-carousel, large-empty-state, bottom-pill, safe-area-aware, minimal, asymmetrical-whitespace, hand-drawn-icons","functions":"Element-level (specific actions):
- Tap top icons: user taps any top category icon to switch the current content filter. The tapped icon animates into the selected rounded square state (lavender fill) and the content area updates. Visual feedback includes scale, color change, and shadow.
- Horizontal swipe: the top icons can be horizontally scrolled (swipe left/right) to reveal more categories; partial icons at edges indicate additional content.
- Tap center plus: opens the "create memory" flow — either a new screen or modal where the user can add photos, notes, or tags. The plus is the primary CTA and provides an immediate way to add the first memory.
- Tap bottom pill icons: quick category shortcuts or navigation within the app. The active icon highlights with a deep indigo filled tile; tapping switches context and visually confirms selection with an animation.

Medium-level tasks / flows:
- Add a new memory for the selected category: user selects a category from the top icons (or bottom pill), taps the large plus to create a memory, fills details (photo, text, date), and saves. The UI flows from the empty screen into a creation modal and then shows the new memory in the canvas area (not shown here).
- Browse categories: user scrolls the top icon carousel or uses the bottom quick-pick pill to filter different collection sets (e.g., flora, fauna, places), enabling discovery of previously saved items. If there are none for that category, the empty state remains and prompts creation.

High-level goal:
- The screen's purpose is to present the current category of "memories" (or moments) and invite the user to add content when none exists. It acts as a contextual home for a category — showing the date and the currently selected category while guiding the user to the primary action (create a memory). The UI is designed to be clear and frictionless: selection is obvious, the add action is prominent, and quick navigation is available through the pill at the bottom. The empty-state messaging clarifies that there is currently no stored memory in this context and invites contribution."}},{"name":"New entry editor (initial)","screen_id":"5669d739-9252-4b13-a8c8-7b652471dbba","refero_url":"https://refero.design/screens/5669d739-9252-4b13-a8c8-7b652471dbba","thumbnail_url":"https://images.refero.design/screenshots/268/mobile/7f1ae15e-fd9e-4d72-9fa8-24eabc87a604_thumb.jpg","goal":"Begin composing a new memory","action":"User taps into the text area (placeholder 'Start writing') and the on-screen keyboard appears","system_response":"Cursor is shown in the text area and the keyboard stays visible. A small image icon is visible near the keyboard for attaching photos. A 'Done' button is available to finish.","ux_patterns":["Empty State","Add & Create"],"ui_elements":["Button","Floating Button","Text Field","Icon","Onscreen Keyboard"],"content":{"description":"High-level: A minimal, single-screen mobile writing interface (portrait). The top area is a large empty writing canvas with a centered rounded-square icon near the top and a left-aligned placeholder text “Start writing”. The system keyboard occupies the lower ~40% of the screen. Two floating interactive elements sit just above the keyboard: a small square image/attachment icon on the lower-left and a rounded rectangular “Done” button on the lower-right.

Background and overall style:
- Background is a very light neutral gray, almost off-white. Approximate color: #EFEFF1 (RGB 239,239,241).
- Visual style is soft, playful, minimal; many elements use rounded corners, drop shadows and saturated purple/blue accent colors.

Top-centered icon (app/feature icon):
- Rounded square 64x64 px (approx) with soft corners (radius ~12 px). Background of the icon card is a pale lavender (~#E7E1FF or RGB 231,225,255).
- Inside the card is a simple line-illustration (flame-like strokes) in a saturated electric blue / violet (approx #2A00FF or RGB 42,0,255). The stroke is hand-drawn style — variable thickness.
- The icon card has a diffuse drop shadow directly beneath it: shadow color #000 with low opacity (~10%), vertical offset ~6 px, blur ~20 px.

Placeholder text (main input area):
- Text reads “Start writing” and is left-aligned, positioned about 24–32 px from the left edge and 120–140 px from the top of the screen (under the centered icon). The caret is visible to the left of the placeholder indicating focused editable area.
- Typeface appears monospaced or a typewriter-style display (visual vibe: Courier / SF Mono / typewriter). Use a medium weight with letter spacing slightly wide; font size approximately 22–28 pt (mobile scale). Color is a pale lavender/purple (#BFAEFF or RGB 191,174,255) giving a low-contrast, subtle affordance.
- The caret is slim and colored a vivid blue (approx #2A7CFF) to show focus.

Floating attachment icon (bottom-left):
- Small rounded-square button (approx 48x48 px) with the same pale lavender card background as the top icon (#E7E1FF).
- Inside is a line illustration of a photo/landscape in the same saturated electric blue (#2A00FF). The icon has its own soft shadow (offset down-right, blur ~14 px, opacity ~12%).
- This functions as an attachment / insert image control.

Done button (bottom-right):
- Rounded rectangle, bright saturated deep blue / violet background (#2A00FF or #1A00E8). Width approx 84 px, height 44 px, corner radius around 10–12 px.
- Label reads “Done” in white or very pale lavender; the typography appears slightly handwritten/rounded with medium weight; text centered vertically and horizontally. Use white text color #FFFFFF.
- The button floats above the content and keyboard with a small shadow (blur ~8–12 px, opacity ~18%).

Keyboard area:
- Native iOS-style QWERTY keyboard filling the bottom ~40% of the screen. Keys are white with subtle rounded corners and thin dark-gray labels (#222). The predictive bar is visible above the keys with three suggestions (“I”, “The”, “I’m”).
- Keyboard background is light gray (#F4F5F7) with a subtle top edge radius where it meets the canvas. The keyboard visually overlaps the canvas.

Spacing and layout:
- The top safe/ status area has the clock and status icons at the top corners (9:41 on the left, signal/wifi/battery on the right) — standard iOS status bar.
- The editable canvas occupies the full width and remaining vertical space between status bar and keyboard. Large vertical whitespace, left padding ~24 px for text.
- Floating controls (attachment icon and Done button) are anchored just above the keyboard, positioned at the extreme left and right with about 16–20 px margin from edges.

Color palette (recommended approximations):
- Canvas background: #EFEFF1 (RGB 239,239,241)
- Icon card background (lavender): #E7E1FF (RGB 231,225,255)
- Accent / line art / primary action: #2A00FF (RGB 42,0,255) — vivid electric blue/violet
- Placeholder text (lavender): #BFAEFF (RGB 191,174,255)
- Done button text: #FFFFFF
- Shadows: rgba(0,0,0,0.08) to rgba(0,0,0,0.18)
- Keyboard keys background: #FFFFFF with labels #222222

Typography:
- Placeholder / main text: monospaced or typewriter-style face (e.g., 'SF Mono' or 'Courier New'), size ~22–28 pt, medium weight. Line-height ~1.25–1.4.
- Button label: rounded humanist / display font, medium weight, ~16–18 pt, all-caps not used (normal capitalization).
- Iconography: hand-drawn stroke style, consistent stroke weight ~2–3 px.

States and interactions:
- Placeholder fades out and caret blinks when user types. Caret color is vivid blue (#2A7CFF).
- Attachment button has a touch highlight (brief scale down or brightness increase) and may open a photo picker overlay.
- Done triggers a commit/save action; when pressed it likely dismisses keyboard and returns to previous screen. Button has pressed state (darker blue, slight inset shadow) and disabled state (muted gray).

Animation suggestions (if re-creating):
- Icon and attachment have subtle drop shadow animations when pressed: scale to 0.96 over 60 ms with easing cubic-out.
- Done button: quick color change + 60 ms scale when tapped; keyboard appears/disappears with standard iOS slide animation (duration ~250 ms, cubic-bezier .2,.8,.2,1).

Accessibility notes:
- Contrast of placeholder to background is low; ensure the editable text uses a darker color when actual content is entered (e.g., #111111) for readability.
- All touch targets should be >=44x44 px; attachment and Done buttons should meet this rule.

Screen summary (to recreate):
- Full-screen mobile screen with a light gray canvas, centered decorative icon near top, left-aligned placeholder text “Start writing” in pale lavender, bottom native keyboard visible, floating image-attachment icon bottom-left and rounded bright blue Done button bottom-right.","layout":"General layout: single-column vertical flow with two primary vertical zones.
- Top zone (canvas): occupies roughly 60% of vertical space. Contains a centered rounded-square icon at the top (one column center), then a left-aligned text input area starting under the icon. This area is intentionally mostly empty to encourage free typing.
- Bottom zone (interaction area): the system keyboard occupies the lower ~40% of the screen and visually anchors the floating controls.

Columns and groups:
- The entire screen uses one main column (full-width) for the canvas and editor. There are no multi-column grids in the canvas area.
- Floating controls form a two-item group horizontally aligned above the keyboard: left cluster (attachment icon) and right cluster (Done button). They behave like absolute-positioned elements anchored to the keyboard top edge.

Grid and alignment specifics:
- Left margin for text content ~24 px. Top-center icon is horizontally centered in the single column.
- The keyboard is full-width and flush with the bottom edge; the floating controls are positioned with horizontal margins: attachment icon ~16–20 px from left edge, Done button ~16–20 px from right edge.
- Predictive suggestions bar sits directly above the keyboard keys and is center-aligned across the keyboard width.

Keywords describing structural layout: single-column, full-bleed canvas, floating controls, anchored keyboard, centered header icon, left-aligned input, bottom action, large whitespace, absolute-positioned buttons, simple hierarchy.","functions":"Specific actions (micro):
- Tapping the empty text area or the visible caret activates the text input and opens the system keyboard (already visible in the screenshot); users can enter characters via the keyboard.
- Using the predictive bar above the keyboard to insert suggested words (“I”, “The”, “I’m”).
- Tapping the small image/landscape icon (bottom-left) to open a media picker or attach an image into the note/draft.
- Pressing the Done button (bottom-right) to complete the writing session: this likely saves or publishes the content and dismisses the editor and keyboard.
- The editable area supports typical text-editing gestures: caret placement by tap, selection by long-press, copy/paste from the system menu.

Medium-level tasks (workflows):
- Compose a new note: open the screen, type text in the large canvas area, optionally attach images via the image icon, use predictive bar for quicker typing, then press Done to save.
- Edit an existing short text: focus appears on the text area with caret, update content, and press Done to apply changes.
- Insert media: tap attachment icon to choose photo from library or camera, preview or position image in-line, then continue typing and press Done when finished.

Broader purpose / user goals (macro):
- Provide a minimal distraction-free writing surface for quick notes, drafts, or short posts. The screen streamlines the create/compose flow by removing extraneous chrome and exposing only essential controls (attach + Done).
- Facilitate quick capture of text and media, saving it with a single commit action. The design emphasizes speed and immediacy: big whitespace for thinking/typing, a clear call-to-action (Done), and easy media insertion."}},{"name":"Typing text","screen_id":"0863f008-be03-4696-8e64-b893c536decb","refero_url":"https://refero.design/screens/0863f008-be03-4696-8e64-b893c536decb","thumbnail_url":"https://images.refero.design/screenshots/268/mobile/eb078071-3063-4641-9daa-4b499196031c_thumb.jpg","goal":"Write the daily reflection","action":"User enters text describing their day","system_response":"Typed text is rendered in the entry area in real time; keyboard suggestions are shown above the keyboard","ux_patterns":["Article & Text","Add & Create"],"ui_elements":["Button","Floating Button","Text Field","Icon","Onscreen Keyboard"],"content":{"description":"Full-screen mobile writing/composition interface with an iOS keyboard visible at the bottom. Background is a very light neutral gray (suggested #F2F3F4) with a subtle, soft radial lightening toward the center. A single, prominent rounded-square icon is centered near the top of the screen (about 12-18% from the top edge). That icon has a pale lavender rounded-square background (suggested #E6DCFF) with a hand-drawn, wavy flame-like glyph stroked in a saturated royal/purple-blue (suggested #2B21FF). The icon has a soft drop shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0px 8px 18px) and a small inner highlight to suggest depth.

Main content is a large multi-line plain-text input area (looks like a monospaced or slab monospace typeface such as Courier / Menlo / IBM Plex Mono) in a saturated blue color (#2B21FF). The text is left-aligned and positioned roughly centered horizontally with a comfortable left margin (approx 12-16% of the screen width). The text block begins beneath the top icon and continues down toward the keyboard; in the screenshot there are ~7–9 lines of text visible. Font size is large for legibility on mobile — approx 22–28px (depending on device DPR) with line-height ~1.25–1.4 to create tight but readable line spacing. The cursor is visible at the end of the last line.

A small square rounded image/photo icon sits above the keyboard at the lower-left area of the content region (a rounded square with a light lavender/pale background #E6DCFF and a purple-blue line drawing of a landscape/thumbnail inside). That icon casts the same subtle drop shadow as the top icon. On the lower-right, slightly above the keyboard, is a prominent call-to-action button labeled “Done.” This Done button is a rounded rectangle, filled with the same saturated purple-blue (#2B21FF) and the label is a hand-drawn / casual white type (or white text with ~600 weight). The button size is compact for thumb reach (approx 56–64px wide by 40–48px tall depending on screen) with a corner radius around 10–14 px. The button also has a soft shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.12)).

The system status bar appears at the top (time left, signal/battery right) consistent with iOS. The keyboard is native iOS style: light translucent background with rounded, white keycaps, and a suggestion bar directly above the keys showing quick suggestions (I, I'm, But). The keyboard covers the lower ~40% of the screen; the content and bottom controls are positioned above it in the safe area. There are no visible toolbars aside from these two corner action controls (image icon and Done). The overall aesthetic is minimal, calm, and tactile with high-contrast blue text on a muted background and soft rounded shapes for interactive controls.

Color palette (suggested matches from screenshot):
- Background / overall page: #F2F3F4 (very light gray)
- Primary accent / text / glyphs / CTA: #2B21FF (royal/purple-blue)
- Icon background / soft lavender: #E6DCFF
- CTA text / icon strokes: #FFFFFF (white)
- Drop shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.12)

Typography (recommended to match visual):
- Body / typed text: Monospaced or slab-monospace like 'Courier New', 'Menlo', or 'IBM Plex Mono', font-size 22–28px, font-weight 400 (regular), line-height 1.25–1.4, color #2B21FF, left-aligned. Large letter-spacing is visible (slightly expanded, +0.5 to +1px) to get the spaced typewriter-like look.
- CTA button: Rounded button text in a casual/handwritten style or a rounded humanist font, 16–18px, font-weight 600, color #FFFFFF.

UI states and micro-interactions: keyboard raising/dismissing (native iOS). Tapping the image icon opens an image picker sheet. Tapping Done validates/saves the entry and dismisses keyboard; the Done button should show a pressed state (slightly darker fill, inner shadow) and a brief success toast or transition. Icons and buttons use subtle shadow and scale-on-press micro-interactions (scale to ~0.98, 80–120ms easing). No complex animations present in static screen.

Margins / spacing (approx):
- Screen safe area padding top: 16–22px; main icon 12–18% from top center.
- Horizontal content margin: 12–16% left/right for the text block (text starts slightly inset to the right of center to create breathing space).
- Spacing between top icon and first line of text: ~28–36px.
- Spacing between last line and the action controls (image icon / Done): ~18–26px above keyboard.

Layout guidance: single-column composition with floating controls above keyboard; visual emphasis on large readable text and minimal actions.","layout":"Single-column, full-screen composition with content stacked vertically. Top area: status bar then a centered rounded-square icon (single column group). Middle area: large multiline text input occupying the central column (one column). Bottom area above the keyboard: two small controls aligned to the left and right (two-column group inside the single-column layout): a rounded photo/attachment icon at the lower-left and a primary action (Done) rounded rectangle at the lower-right. The onscreen keyboard occupies the lower portion and overlays the bottom of the content when active.

Columns/groups count: 1 main column (vertical). Within the lower content area, there is a grouped two-column layout for the two floating controls (left icon, right CTA). There is no visible grid of multiple content columns; content aligns within a single center-left column. The text area itself acts like a vertical list of text rows (7–9 visible rows of the text block).

Keywords to describe layout structure: centered header icon, single-column stack, floating bottom controls, two-column bottom group, keyboard overlay, large text area, safe-area padding, left-aligned text block, roomy margins, minimal chrome.","functions":"Specific actions available on this screen:
- Enter multi-line text: user can type into a large text field using the onscreen keyboard. The text input supports line breaks and a visible cursor. Visual cues (monospaced blue text) indicate editable content.
- Use word suggestions: suggestion bar above the keyboard shows quick completions the user can tap.
- Attach or insert an image: tapping the rounded image/photo icon in the lower-left launches an image picker or attachment flow. The icon provides an affordance for adding media and has a tactile shadow and hover/pressed states.
- Save/complete entry: tapping the “Done” button in the lower-right triggers save/submit behavior, closes the keyboard, and confirms the entry (could show a transient success message or return to a list). The button uses clear color contrast and is reachable by thumb.
- Native keyboard controls: user can switch to numbers/symbols (123 key), use the return key to insert newlines, use microphone icon for voice input, and use backspace to delete.

Medium-level workflows enabled:
- Compose a daily journal or short article: user types freeform text, optionally attaches one or more images, and taps Done to save a single entry.
- Quick reflection capture: the large type and minimal distractions support quick capture of thoughts with easy saving.
- Inline editing and revision: user can re-open this editor to modify previously saved content and re-save via Done.

Broader purpose facilitated by this screen:
